text_block_list.text: The Umamusume were running the Selection Race. Wondering what kind of Umamusume I'd meet, I headed to the venue full of anticipation…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's fine… I trained properly. I can definitely win. I'll take first. With my own two legs…
I saw Gold City on the entry list. She was psyching herself up, visibly tense…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What gives all of a sudden… Who're you? Those clothes… Tracen Academy trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but if you wanna talk, wait till after the Selection Race. Till then, pass.
After brushing me off coldly, Gold City walked away…
Selection Race got underway, looking over next heat's paddock sheet—

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Whoa, gorgeous…! Look at her…! Is she the one from the rumors?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Um… A-Are you who I think you are…!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Yeah? You talkin' to me?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I knew it! You're that model City-chan, right? Saw you in magazines, but you're ridiculously pretty in person~…!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah-… Thanks a lot.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Well now, with such a beauty on track, I can't wait for the race~. Do your best, City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sure. I'll do my best so my running captivates you.
After all that buzz, race kicked off—

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Gold City can't make up ground from behind! Final 400m! Is it too late!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*… *pant*… Like hell I'm done…! I've still got… plenty left…!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: —And across the line!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *gasp*… *pant*… 5th place, huh… Damn it.
Gold City surged hard near the end, but unfortunately, it wasn't enough for a top spot…

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Hmm, nice burst at the final stretch, but overall nothing special—just run-of-the-mill. Guess balancing modeling and racing really is too much to ask.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text: More importantly, look at that form! That tail and chestnut hair flowing in the wind was pure art. Man, what a treat for the eyes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Tch.
Gold City walked off in silence. The bitter frustration written across her face left a deep impression on me…
Walking along riverbed at dusk, turning over Selection Race in mind—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, City, timeout-timeout~! Seriously dyin' here~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *pant*… *pant*… What, Jordan, gassed out already?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No, feet are killin' me too… But City, aren't your legs totally shot? You just raced today, don't overdo it~.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: …City, Jordan-san is right.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, where'd you pop in from? Scared the crap outta me~…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Manager… What, were you watching?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Pushing yourself like this will affect tomorrow's shoot. What if you trip and injure yourself running all sloppy like that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, yeah. I won't damage your merchandise.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: City… Please understand. I'm saying this for your own sake.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: Picked job perfectly matching your brand tomorrow. Cool, refined, dazzling—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …I do my job properly!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You've taken care of me and I'm grateful. It's my work, so I'm not saying I'll quit modeling right this second.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But running and training is what I wanna do! How many times do I gotta say "stay out of my way"!?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: …I've been against this from the start. City, you truly don't grasp your own worth…!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Worth? That's not my worth—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Crap! I am crave-craving some hot stew right now~!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: 'Cause like~, you kept saying City, City! Doesn't "City" and "stew" kinda sound alike? Got me super hungry~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So hey, Manager-san. Mind if we grab a bite~?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: …Understood. In that case, I have prep work for tomorrow's meeting… City, please be careful not to hurt yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …She gone? Phew~, that was intense~. Manager-san hasn't changed a bit~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: *sigh*… Sorry, Jordan. You bailed me out, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! City actually droppin' a legit "thanks", that's hilarious✰

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Also, totally wasn't kidding about being starved. Wanna go hit dinner soon?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Sorry. Gonna run a bit more. Go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real~? Gotcha~. Don't push too hard, 'kay? Catch ya later~.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …Alright. Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Not just something pretty to gawk at. Not some hollow doll—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna prove who I really am…!
Drenched in sweat, pushing through the setting sun, she was more breathtaking than any Umamusume I'd ever seen…
